mesh_rule: Start with H4 physical knots. IB divides first 3 wall cells above each base into 4 each. IY divides first and last Y cells into 4 each, second and penultimate into 2 each. IBY combines both. Other wall/roof/arc/thickness cells unchanged; no hanging nodes. This structured grading affects connected rows along the bay; it is not an unstructured adaptive mesh.
interpretation: Controlled directional sensitivity for FULL only, not an all-direction convergence sequence; no extrapolation to LEFT or other thicknesses.
unchanged: t175 / exterior 3x3m including floor / R.40 / bay1.50m / NC320 E28321.786532937494MPa nu.20 rho2400 / F-R bonded crown and same face-base restraints / free Y sides / uncracked / explicit consistent SW plus vertical roof LL50kgf/m2 / floor separate LP-A / no prestress in this trial

cut_audit.method: Integrate sigma*n dA and (x-origin) cross sigma*n on both element traces of each section; no averaging across the interface. Compare lower trace to nodal cut and upper to opposite nodal cut. No equivalent load subtraction from continuum stress traction; nodal cut reference already subtracts selected elements' consistent face-node loads.
cut_audit.moment_origin: Same physical section mid-thickness and Y=.75 as nodal cut

local_sampling: Same 490 S2E physical XYZ points and s/y/n axes, one-sided values retained. Apply unchanged 5% point/RMS/spread diagnostics; a sensitivity pair meeting them is not whole-model convergence.
limits: No change to actual support/crown design, contact or stiffness
No thickness or arc refinement in directional meshes
No exact full-bay reference, concrete cracking, lateral/uplift, handling, openings or design approval
Cut-traction integration is an independent postprocessing check, not an independent FE formulation
No code strength, reinforcement or bolt design
